verdict.rationale: The manual documents previews of HTML and document files [docs-3]. The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom [docs-13]. It also offers a JavaScript console for debugging [docs-38] and an External URL option for previewing from other devices [docs-39]. Missing for 10: Markdown rendering is not explicitly named (only "document files"), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of live reload.
